en.headline: 10-year-old boy dies after collapsing at home in Happy Valley
en.dek: Police were called to a Happy Valley flat on Sunday evening after a child was found unconscious; he was certified dead at Ruttonjee Hospital and the cause of death is pending autopsy.
body: A 10-year-old boy was certified dead at Ruttonjee Hospital on Sunday evening after collapsing at a home in Happy Valley, according to police and hospital-bound ambulance reports carried by local news outlets.

Police received a report at about 7pm from a woman who said her son had been found unconscious in a room at a Wong Nai Chung Road address. Ambulance crews took the boy, who was in a coma, to Ruttonjee Hospital, where he was later certified dead.
The cause of death has not been determined and will be established after an autopsy, police said. No further official details on the circumstances inside the flat have been released.
The case was reported without any indication of foul play in the initial police account. The family has not been named.

zh.headline: 跑馬地10歲男童家中暈倒 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方周日傍晚接報，跑馬地黃泥涌道一個單位有男童懷疑暈倒，男童昏迷送往律敦治醫院後證實死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 一名10歲男童周日晚上在跑馬地寓所內暈倒，送往律敦治醫院後證實死亡。警方及多家本地傳媒引述救援消息報道事件。
警方晚上約七時接獲一名女子報案，指其兒子在黃泥涌道一個單位的房間內懷疑暈倒。救援人員到場後，男童已陷入昏迷，由救護車送往律敦治醫院搶救，其後證實不治。
警方表示，男童死因有待驗屍後確定，暫時未有公布更多單位內的情冰。初步報道未有提及案件涉及可疑。
男童及家人身份未被公開。
